sources.title: British Gas owner Centrica plans overhaul with 1,300 job cuts over two years
sources.description: The changes will lead to an approximately 14% reduction in the company’s customer operations workforce.

sources.title: British Gas Owner's AI Drive Leaves 1,300 Call Centre Workers Without Jobs
sources.description: Centrica is cutting 1,300 customer service jobs as AI reshapes British Gas operations, with unions warning of job losses and critics fearing vulnerable customers may be left behind.
